notes: When world.defense_futile_attacks of his attacks in a row leave the player unharmed, Mahoraga studies how: the first row the player has (any of perks picked, or immunity = a full Adapt to Anything immunity) and he has not adapted to yet. evasion has no perks: it is what is left when nothing else explains it. Each one is a full adaptation (heal, x2 health and damage). counter: untag = his projectiles lose the "projectile" tag that repulsion/slowing fields look for; break_shield = every attack empties the player's energy shields; pierce = his damage also comes as curse damage (world.pierce_curse_frac); sense = he no longer needs to see the player; haste = shorter cooldowns and faster projectiles.

rows.message: Your fields no longer push or slow his attacks.
Every blow now shatters your shield.
His attacks now pierce protections with cursed power.
He no longer needs to see you.
He strikes faster, and his attacks fly faster.
